snippet.title: NBA Inside Drive 2000 Gameplay | HD
snippet.description:
NBA Inside Drive was a series of basketball video games published by Microsoft Game Studios. NBA Inside Drive 2000 was the first in the series and was released only for PC, later followed by NBA Inside Drive 2002, 2003, 2004  released only fox Xbox.

NBA Inside Drive for PC was released on August 27, 1999. It was pretty solid game by my opinion (at least until NBA live 2000 for PC was released). I especially like the commentary duo and three throw shooting mechanics in this game.
